analysis.session_summary: The window from Friday 07:00 through Monday 07:00 was quiet for the USD but not for cross-currents: JPY led major strength at +0.116%, followed by GBP +0.108% and CHF +0.078%, while CAD lagged at -0.152%, NZD -0.094%, and EUR -0.09%. DXY closed +4.3 points, SPX +24.8 points, and VIX -9.4 points near the lows, but most FX legs had no clear catalyst. BOJ Ueda headlines and a normal UK retail-sales beat were the main measurable impulses; EUR/USD closed -11.9 pips and USD/JPY -11.5 pips.

themes.evidence: JPY mean strength +0.116%; BOJ Press Conference own-impulse +0.204% unscored; USD/JPY -11.5 pips and CHF/JPY -8.0 pips with Ueda headlines credited inside legs.
CAD weakest at -0.152%, NZD -0.094%, EUR -0.09%; USD/CAD +22.2 pips to 1.40047; USD/SEK +282.7 pips and USD/MXN +750.9 pips.

themes.theme: Sparse event reaction and flow-driven tape
themes.evidence: Most legs carry no clear catalyst; ECB Lagarde reaction muted at -0.038% inside noise floor, while UK Retail Sales was normal polarity with GBP stronger 0.042%.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD printed a 35.6-pip range and closed at 1.14748, down -11.9 pips; five legs alternated with no single catalyst, with UK Retail Sales +2.5 pips and Ueda +5.8 pips credited during a 10.4-pip up leg.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: GBP/USD gained 9.1 pips to 1.3378 in a 62.5-pip range; an early down leg cited Lagarde -11.4 pips, followed by a 60.4-pip up leg with no clear catalyst and a late 18.8-pip fade.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: USD/JPY closed -11.5 pips at 157.018 with a 153.8-pip range; whipsaw legs around Ueda headlines included a +122.5-pip up leg driven by Ueda items and a -136.8-pip down leg with no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: USD/CHF lost -3.6 pips to 0.8231 in a 49.6-pip range; an early +20.6-pip up leg cited Lagarde +5.9 pips, then a -41.1-pip down leg had no clear catalyst and a late 14.2-pip up leg moved against the Trump-Iran headline.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: AUD/USD closed -1.6 pips at 0.71271 in a 26.1-pip range; six small legs mostly lacked catalysts, with Lagarde -3.6 pips in an early down leg and a late 5.3-pip up leg after NZ data.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: NZD/USD fell -6.3 pips to 0.57232 in a 24.2-pip range; the largest leg was a -14.9-pip down leg citing Lagarde -4.6 pips, with the rest small and catalyst-light.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: USD/CAD rose 22.2 pips to 1.40047 in a 34.6-pip range; legs alternated with no clear catalysts beyond Lagarde +5.0 pips in an early +30.2-pip up leg.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: EUR/CHF fell -13.9 pips to 0.94448 in a 54.4-pip range; an early +15.4-pip up leg had Retail Sales +2.8 and Ueda +2.6, then a long -30.9-pip down leg with no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: CHF/JPY lost -8.0 pips to 190.794 in a wide 174.3-pip range; Ueda headlines drove a +137.9-pip up leg, then large flows without clear catalyst.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: EUR/GBP fell -14.8 pips to 0.8577 in a 24.6-pip range; a Saudis headline contributed -3.2 pips to an early down leg, followed by no-catalyst and a small late up leg.
leg_notes.AUD/NZD: AUD/NZD rose 10.8 pips to 1.2452 in a 63.6-pip range; a Retail Sales item added +4.9 pips to an initial up leg, then a -57.5-pip down leg lacked clear catalyst, and a later +42.5-pip up leg moved against the Trump-Greenland headline.
leg_notes.AUD/CHF: AUD/CHF fell -4.0 pips to 0.58661 in a 44.0-pip range; an early +10.5-pip up leg included BOJ Press Conference +2.5 and Retail Sales +1.8, then a -37.1-pip down leg with no clear catalyst, then a 21.5-pip up leg.
leg_notes.NZD/CHF: NZD/CHF fell -7.2 pips to 0.47107 in a 26.3-pip range; an initial -20.7-pip down leg had no clear catalyst, then a +13.8-pip up leg after UK property headline.

polarity_reads.read: Unscored because no forecast, but JPY strengthened 0.204% on its own impulse, suggesting the market treated Ueda's guidance as hawkish for JPY and is sensitive to BOJ carry-unwind communication.
Muted; the EUR basket moved only -0.038% inside the noise floor, implying no fresh hawkish impulse and no positioning squeeze around Lagarde.
Normal polarity; actual 0.5% versus -0.2% forecast produced GBP stronger 0.042%, confirming GBP data surprises are still traded conventionally rather than inverted.

scenarios.name: BOJ hawkish extension / carry unwind
scenarios.thesis: Measured JPY strength +0.116% and BOJ Press Conference own-impulse +0.204% dominate; if Ueda keeps signaling hikes, carry unwind forces more JPY/CHF demand and pressures EUR/CAD crossers.
triggers: BOJ Press Conference or new Ueda headlines after 07:00
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recaptures 157.018 and holds above the 153.8-pip range high; BOJ headlines stop.

pair_paths.rationale: Matches this window's largest USD/JPY down leg -136.8 pips when Ueda headlines were followed by no-catalyst selling.
Matches largest EUR/USD down leg -31.9 pips; weak EUR mean -0.09% and USD carry support lower.
Matches largest CHF/JPY down leg -121.3 pips; JPY strength dominates the cross.
Matches largest USD/CHF down leg -41.1 pips; haven CHF bid extends.

scenarios.name: Risk-on USD softness and high-beta recovery
scenarios.thesis: SPX +24.8 points and VIX -9.4 points at 17.71725 show risk appetite; if geopolitics stay quiet and oil slips, high-beta and commodity FX recover, with USD weakening against CAD, NZD, and GBP.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/CAD breaks above 1.40047 and holds; VIX rises; Trump-Iran or Saudi oil headline escalates.

pair_paths.rationale: Matches largest USD/CAD down leg -28.5 pips; CAD recovery from -0.152% weakest vs majors.
Matches largest GBP/USD up leg +60.4 pips; GBP strength +0.108% supports.
Matches largest AUD/USD up leg +20.1 pips; risk-on high-beta recovery.
Matches largest NZD/USD up leg +17.4 pips; NZD base from -0.094% mean.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: The coming window has only two medium-impact central bank speakers: ECB President Lagarde at 17:00 and BOC Governor Macklem at 17:05. The last Lagarde reaction was muted basket -0.038% inside the noise floor, so unless she deviates, the calendar may not break ranges, but Macklem can move CAD after USD/CAD +22.2 pips and CAD -0.152% weakness.
